propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters) must block both plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM call or context assembly.

The 8,000-character threshold is calibrated from historical corpus analysis (p99 7,500 chars) and affects only 0.82% of current tickets while materially improving plan-review latency and completion PASS rates.
Plan-review blocking P4 description findings must be partitioned in light-bug-review to retain only the description block in det_blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.

Completion verification must check description length immediately after authoritative ticket load and return a deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if oversized, without truncating or summarizing content.
